name: LiveKit
title: livekit.io
payoff: Voice AI platform for real-time agents
shortDescription: LiveKit offers a robust platform for building, deploying, and scaling real-time voice agents. It is designed for both startups and large enterprises, providing an open-source, enterprise-grade solution. Users can integrate seamlessly with telephony systems and manage global communications with low latency. Example use case includes deploying voice agents for customer support in a multinational corporation.
cons: May require technical expertise to deploy
Limited information on direct customer support
Potential complexity in initial setup for less tech-savvy users
